claim: Every claim that AGENTS.md asserts as foundational MUST originate from an addressable, schema-validated, ledger-witnessed entry in the constitutional invariant registry at .gzkit/invariants/. AGENTS.md is rendered from the registry; drift between rendered view and committed AGENTS.md is fail-closed at gz validate --invariant-coherence (and gz check). Hand-authoring foundational claims directly into AGENTS.md is the same class of failure as hand-writing ledger entries (AGENTS.md § Behavior Rules — Never #2 applied at the canon layer).
